name: Weather Observatory
summary: Local weather, forecasts, marine conditions, tides, alerts and radar in an independent module.
capabilities: Uses macOS Location access to follow this Mac, with manual place override
Fetches selected-place forecasts from NOAA, Open-Meteo and MET Norway
Reads marine, tide, air quality, alert and radar feeds
Displays attributed maps, radar playback and regional wind inside the Nook
Stores only this module's location, units and cached readings
Includes its own weather worker and runtime; no companion app required
Exports read-only weather status through the shared plugin SDK
